label: Pit-Fiend Juggernaut first encounter

purpose.value: Word of the ten realms' fall has reached the Pit-Fiend Juggernaut; it meets the hero with dread and sheer mass — and still offers the law's fair warning first.

emotionalProgression.note: It knows exactly what happened to the ten guardians.
Mass and warning together: turn back, or be turned.

notes: The bench guardians have heard what happened to the ten realms; the dread is informed, not naive. The fair warning still comes first. True role (cave-in rescue in the deep settlements) may be hinted to the player; the hero reads only a monster.
